display.purpose: Headline stop name on the route blind, in bus yellow.

headline.purpose: Card and section titles; all h1-h3 default to Overpass 800.

body.purpose: All reading text at an 18px root, tabular numerals on.

label.purpose: Stop dates, tab labels, blind data terms, status pills; sentence case.

figure.purpose: Every money amount and stop date, right-aligned like a timetable.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Every card and the reset dialog. Dark mode: 0 8px 24px -12px oklch(0 0 0 / 60%).

shadows.name: talk-lift
shadows.purpose: The talk button only, lifting it off the blind.

motion.name: ui-transition
motion.purpose: Button background, colour, border and press-scale transitions.

motion.name: talk-rings
motion.value: fola-ring 2.4s infinite, second ring delayed 1.2s; 1.1s while Fola speaks
motion.purpose: Yellow rings scale 1 to 1.55 and fade behind the talk button while listening or speaking.

motion.name: stop-tick
motion.purpose: The newest journey-log stop ticks when its action is approved.

motion.name: caption-in
motion.purpose: Each voice caption sentence arrives whole; no typewriter.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: rings hidden; animation and transition durations 0.01ms

components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: oklch(0.178 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.885 0.005 106); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0 0 / 6%), 0 6px 18px -10px oklch(0.2 0 0 / 22%); padding: 20px; max-width: 420px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0; font: 800 27px/1.15 Overpass, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-route { position: relative; list-style: none; margin: 12px 0 0; padding: 0; } .ds-route::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 1.4rem; bottom: 1.4rem; width: 8px; background: oklch(0.866 0.177 90); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-route li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; column-gap: 12px; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-route small { display: block; font: 800 15px Overpass, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.43 0.008 106); } .ds-route b { display: block; font-size: 18px; } .ds-stop { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; border: 6px solid oklch(0.178 0 0); box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-stop[data-tone='chance'] { border-color: oklch(0.866 0.177 90); background: oklch(0.962 0.068 96); } .ds-stop[data-tone='risk'] { border-color: oklch(0.53 0.2 28); } .ds-stop[data-tone='here'] { background: oklch(0.866 0.177 90); } .ds-stop[data-tone='done'] { background: oklch(0.51 0.13 150); border-color: oklch(0.51 0.13 150); } .ds-fig { font: 800 20px Overpass, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-align: right; } .ds-gain { color: oklch(0.51 0.13 150); } @keyframes ds-stop-tick { 0% { transform: scale(0.6); } 60% { transform: scale(1.18); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } } .ds-tick { animation: ds-stop-tick 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }

components.css: .ds-talk-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 48px; background: oklch(0.958 0.003 106); } .ds-talk { position: relative; width: 152px; height: 152px; } .ds-talk-btn { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 999px; border: 6px solid oklch(0.958 0.003 106); background: oklch(0.866 0.177 90); color: oklch(0.178 0 0); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-talk-btn:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-talk-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.178 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-talk-btn:active { background: oklch(0.178 0 0); color: oklch(0.866 0.177 90); } .ds-ring { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.866 0.177 90); animation: ds-ring 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite; } .ds-ring-delay { animation-delay: 1.2s; } @keyframes ds-ring { 0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.55; } 100% { transform: scale(1.55); opacity: 0; } } .ds-talk-wrap p { margin: 16px 0 0; font: 800 27px Overpass, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.178 0 0); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ring { display: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Fola reads like bus wayfinding. Money is a route you can see ahead: paydays and bills are stops on a thick yellow line, Fola's fixes are the faster route, and every screen opens under a black destination blind that announces where you are going next. The system borrows the blind, the stop pole and the timetable column, and refuses the neobank default of a balance card over a feed of identical cards.

Density is low and targets are large. The app is a single phone column (480px max) on a warm-neutral ground, with white working cards carrying the route, the spotted list and the forecast. One loud colour, bus yellow, marks the things that move you along: the talk button, the route line, the active tab, the focus halo, highlighted text on the blind. Red is a stop at risk, green is money gained, and nothing else is allowed to shout.

Text is set for low vision and low literacy: an 18px root size (scaling to 20px and 23px through the text-size setting), Atkinson Hyperlegible for anything read, Overpass signage for blinds, stop names and figures, and tabular numbers everywhere so amounts line up like a timetable.
keyCharacteristics: Black route blinds, edge to edge, square-cornered, at the top of every screen.
Bus yellow as the single loud colour; stop red and money green as the only semantic voices.
Stops: white discs with a thick ink ring on an 8px yellow line.
Pill-shaped controls at 44-56px tall; 12px cards with a soft ambient shadow.
Signage sans for names and figures, hyperlegible sans for reading.
Motion only where it carries meaning: talk rings, the stop tick, captions rising in.

rules.name: The One Loud Colour Rule
rules.body: Bus yellow is the only saturated accent that may decorate. It marks movement and the next action. Red and green appear only when they mean risk or gain.

rules.name: The Blind Is Ink Rule
rules.body: Headers are route-blind black with white and yellow type. Yellow text sits on black, never on white.

rules.name: The Signage Figure Rule
rules.body: Money and dates are set as signage: Overpass 800 with tabular figures, right-aligned in columns, so amounts read like a timetable.

rules.name: The Root Scales Everything Rule
rules.body: Sizes are rem-based off an 18px root; the text-size setting raises the root (125%, 143.75%). Never set type in px.

rules.name: The Soft-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse and ambient. No hard offset shadows; structure comes from blinds, rules and rings.

dos: Do open every screen with a full-bleed, square, route-blind black header carrying yellow and white type.
Do draw sequences of dated things (payments, months, records) as stops on the 8px yellow line with 34px ringed discs and tone states.
Do set every money figure and stop date in Overpass 800 with tabular figures, right-aligned.
Do make every control a pill or disc at least 44px tall (48px for buttons), with the global 3px ink outline plus 6px yellow halo on focus.
Do use money green only for gain and the Yes action, stop red only for risk and errors.
Do size type in rem off the 18px root so the text-size setting scales the whole app.
Do honour reduced motion: rings off, animations collapsed.
donts: Don't add a second loud accent; bus yellow is the only decorative colour.
Don't put yellow text on white or light surfaces; it belongs on the blind.
Don't round the blinds or sheet tops; signage is square, controls are round.
Don't use hard offset shadows or stacked heavy elevation; Soft and Talk lift are the whole vocabulary.
Don't build screens as a balance card over a feed of identical cards.
Don't add uppercase eyebrows or kickers above headings; labels are sentence-case data terms.
Don't set reading text in Overpass or figures in Atkinson.
